_about: Final-race challenges for GreMi's streams (GreMi 2026-11-22). The pre-stream DM (bot/prestream.py) suggests one per stream, least recently used first. All self-imposed and clean: never anything that makes other lobby drivers' race worse. 'clip' says why it makes a good highlight.

challenges.name: BACK OF THE GRID
challenges.rules: Start last, finish in the points with zero contact.
challenges.clip: Every overtake is a mini highlight; the comeback is the story.

challenges.name: COCKPIT CAM ONLY
challenges.rules: Whole race in cockpit cam, no T-cam or chase cam.
challenges.clip: Raw, scary onboard shots and close calls feel real.

challenges.name: HUD OFF
challenges.rules: No HUD, no minimap, no position tower. Chat tells you your position.
challenges.clip: Chat becomes the race engineer; funny wrong calls.

challenges.name: CHAT PICKS THE STRATEGY
challenges.rules: A chat poll before the start picks the tyres and the lap you pit.
challenges.clip: Viewers own the result, good or terrible.

challenges.name: WRONG TYRE START
challenges.rules: Start on the hardest compound (or inters on a dry track if the lobby allows) and make it work.
challenges.clip: Struggle early, payoff late: built-in story arc.

challenges.name: PIT LANE START
challenges.rules: Start from the pit lane and score points.
challenges.clip: Clear before/after: P20 to the points.

challenges.name: NO BOOST
challenges.rules: No Overtake mode / boost button all race, pure racecraft.
challenges.clip: Old-school overtakes under braking only.

challenges.name: MANUAL AND NO ASSISTS
challenges.rules: Manual gears, traction control and ABS off.
challenges.clip: Lockups, slides and saves make great shorts.

challenges.name: TEN PLACES
challenges.rules: Gain at least 10 places from the start, cleanly.
challenges.clip: A counter on screen keeps viewers watching to the end.

challenges.name: LAP ONE HERO
challenges.rules: Gain 5 places on lap 1 without touching anyone.
challenges.clip: The whole highlight is in the first 90 seconds.

challenges.name: NEMESIS
challenges.rules: Chat picks one driver on the grid; finish ahead of them.
challenges.clip: A personal duel is the easiest story to follow.

challenges.name: FASTEST LAP HUNT
challenges.rules: Set the fastest lap of the race, whatever it costs.
challenges.clip: Late pit stop for softs and a final flying lap.

challenges.name: CLEAN SHEET
challenges.rules: Zero contact, zero penalties, zero track limit warnings. One warning and chat picks a forfeit.
challenges.clip: Fits the clean racing brand; the tension builds every lap.

challenges.name: SLOWEST CAR
challenges.rules: Take the slowest car in the lobby and beat at least one faster car.
challenges.clip: Underdog stories always land.

challenges.name: CHAT PICKS THE TRACK
challenges.rules: Chat votes the track and the weather for the last race.
challenges.clip: Viewers come back to see their pick.

challenges.name: RAIN MASTER
challenges.rules: Last race in the wet, or mixed conditions with a forecast gamble.
challenges.clip: Spray, spins and tyre calls look great on video.

challenges.name: PREDICT YOUR FINISH
challenges.rules: Say your finishing position before the start. Miss it and chat picks the next stream's livery or car.
challenges.clip: Clear hook in the first second: will he hit P5?

challenges.name: SELF COMMENTARY
challenges.rules: Commentate your own race like a TV commentator, all race long.
challenges.clip: Funny voice lines carry the clip without music.

challenges.name: TWO STOPS MINIMUM
challenges.rules: Make at least two pit stops and still finish ahead of where you started.
challenges.clip: Undercut battles and pit exit fights.

challenges.name: MIRRORS ONLY DEFENCE
challenges.rules: No look-back button: defend using only your mirrors, cleanly.
challenges.clip: Tense defending with the cam on the mirrors.
